mapper.select: SELECT coupon_id,coupon_name,threshold_amount,discount_amount,limit_per_member,receive_begin_time,receive_end_time,valid_days,valid_begin_time,valid_end_time,status FROM mall_coupon WHERE coupon_id=#{couponId} AND del_flag='0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT coupon_id,coupon_name,threshold_amount,discount_amount,limit_per_member,receive_begin_time,receive_end_time,valid_days,valid_begin_time,valid_end_time,status FROM mall_coupon WHERE del_flag='0' AND status='0' AND receive_begin_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND receive_end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND received_quantity < total_quantity ORDER BY coupon_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mall_member_coupon WHERE coupon_id=#{couponId} AND member_id=#{memberId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mall_member_coupon WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND status='AVAILABLE' AND valid_begin_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND valid_end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_coupon SET received_quantity=received_quantity+1,version=version+1 WHERE coupon_id=#{couponId} AND del_flag='0' AND status='0' AND received_quantity < total_quantity
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mall_member_coupon AND member_id=#{memberId}AND status=#{status} ORDER BY member_coupon_id DESC

SELECT FROM mall_member_coupon WHERE member_coupon_id=#{memberCouponId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND status='AVAILABLE' AND valid_begin_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND valid_end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_member_coupon SET status='LOCKED',locked_order_id=#{orderId},version=version+1 WHERE member_coupon_id=#{memberCouponId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND status='AVAILABLE' AND threshold_amount_snapshot <= #{orderAmount} AND valid_begin_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND valid_end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
UPDATE mall_member_coupon SET status='AVAILABLE',locked_order_id=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE locked_order_id=#{orderId} AND status='LOCKED'
UPDATE mall_member_coupon SET status='USED',used_order_id=#{orderId},locked_order_id=NULL,use_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE locked_order_id=#{orderId} AND status='LOCKED'
UPDATE mall_member_coupon SET status='EXPIRED',version=version+1 WHERE status='AVAILABLE' AND valid_end_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
